items.title: Ashley Keating and Allan Whitworth Interview, 1963-03-22
items.q: Uh, and, until finally it was narrowed down to white musicians, uh, such as Jimmy McPartland and Max Kaminsky, uh, both of who, uh, did reply, uh, both of whom, I suppose I should say, did reply, but, uh, made demands that the committee couldn't really meet.

ctx.x: How did Ken Collier get that? Whose idea was that?

Uh, the committee, uh, that was elected at the 1961 convention was instructed, uh, by the outgoing committee to, uh, make a search, uh, worldwide, uh, and to bring, uh, as a featured guest, a jazz man of note from some foreign country, preferably America, but, uh, England, or, as long as he was, uh, a jazz man with an international reputation. Uh, I believe several, uh, American jazz men were approached. Kid Orie was, uh, not feeling well. Turk Murphy was too busy. Uh, Louis Armstrong, of course, had other work.…
What is, uh, kind of, uh, committee is this? Explain it exactly. I don't get that.
